name: Landsort
description: The southernmost SAT section on Öja/Landsort, combining village and harbor services with lighthouse views, exposed cliffs, forest singletrack, grazing pastures, bird migration context, Ersta Battery and the northern cape loop. Current SAT facts use the shorter H25 route, while older PDF/Naturkartan/Explore sources still describe a longer 13.6-13.7 km variant.
utilities: Waste is not a supported normal preview facility in the current app model. SAT asks hikers to carry trash back and only use posted harbor waste stations if available and necessary.
Guest-harbor/hostel/lodging showers are guest/customer context only. OSM has a shower node near Norrhamn, but shower is not a supported normal preview facility.
Lodging/cottage sauna or hot-tub context is private/bookable metadata only, not a public trail facility.

facilities.name: Saltboden Kök & Proviant
facilities.description: Combined grocery/provisions shop, cafe, food service and pub in the Landsort village/Västerhamn service cluster. Treat as the main resupply/food marker and use check-current-hours wording, especially outside high summer.

facilities.name: Svedtiljas
facilities.description: Seasonal restaurant at Lotstornet on the south/village part of the route. Normal food import, but exact current opening should be checked before relying on it. Operator pages override broad OSM opening-hour snippets.

facilities.name: Café Norrhamn
facilities.description: Small seasonal cafe/shop context at Norrhamn guest harbor, useful for the northern loop and tent-site area. VisitLandsort describes summer cafe/shop service and daily summer-season opening, while Naturkartan confirms cafe/shop context; keep check-locally wording because no exact public 2026 hours page was found.

facilities.name: Västerhamn public toilets
facilities.description: Public toilet cluster at the western harbor/village service area. SAT names public toilets in the western harbor; OSM maps nearby 24/7 public toilets. Use one cluster marker rather than duplicate pins.

facilities.name: Västerhamn drinking water
facilities.description: Drinking-water tap at the western harbor/village service area. SAT names water in the western harbor; OSM tags the tap with access=yes, fee=no, bottle=yes and 2025 check date.

facilities.name: Norrhamn public toilet
facilities.description: Public toilet at Norrhamn/northern harbor. SAT names public toilets in the northern harbor; Naturkartan and OSM/photo evidence support the WC/dry-toilet context. OSM tags the toilet as fee=yes, so avoid implying it is free.

facilities.name: Norrhamn drinking-water taps
facilities.description: Norrhamn drinking-water cluster. SAT says water is available at the northern harbor; Naturkartan confirms a potable-water tap and warns that water is scarce. OSM maps two current/photo-backed potable taps: one at Norrhamn harbor and one near the tent/rest area. Keep one cluster marker rather than duplicate pins.

facilities.name: Landsorts tältplats
facilities.description: Official designated tent site near Norrhamn/Gethagen. Iteration 3 refines the marker to the OSM campsite way center, still within the Naturkartan/OSM campsite area. This is importable because Öja-Landsort reserve rules allow camping only at designated places.

facilities.name: Rast- och grillplats Öja-Landsort
facilities.description: Designated rest and grill area beside the Norrhamn tent site. Naturkartan says to bring your own wood; reserve rules prohibit fire outside designated sites and fire bans override.

facilities.name: Öja Badplats / Landsort cliff swimming
facilities.description: Natural cliff-swim/bathing spot near the bird-station side of Öja. Explore Archipelago has a dedicated Öja Badplats beach record at this coordinate, and local sources describe bathing from cliffs/smooth rocks around Landsort. Treat as a natural bathing POI only: no municipal water-quality sampling, lifeguard, accessibility, sandy beach or facility claim.
